title: Old-Style Ukrainian Frittata
description: A hearty, Ukrainian-inspired frittata filled with sausage and onions, perfect for a weekend breakfast.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Fresh eggs are essential for a fluffy frittata.

ingredients.name: Old-Style Ukrainian Sausage
ingredients.notes: Use a Ukrainian-style sausage for the most authentic flavor.

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.notes: Caramelized onions add a depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for a more nuanced flavor.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper is essential.

ingredients.name: Fresh Parsley
ingredients.notes: Garnish with fresh parsley for a pop of color.

instructions: In a large skillet, cook the sliced sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Remove the cooked sausage from the skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, cook the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until the onion is caramelized, stirring occasionally.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked sausage, onion mixture, and chopped parsley to the bowl with the eggs and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch (23cm) pie plate or skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
